criteria_verification.notes: voiceTurnStream implemented with io.WebSocket, authenticated connection, JSON frame parsing, and VoiceTurnEvent yield. TranscriptEvent emitted first per wire protocol.
TextTokenEvent emission from type:'token' frames ensures incremental text display. Wire protocol guarantees text tokens arrive before audio_part frames.
AudioPartEvent includes seq field parsed from wire frames. Implementation preserves server ordering for consumer playback queue construction.
fetchAudioChunk propagates wire errors (SessionNotFoundError, 404) enabling UI layer to skip unavailable chunks and continue with remaining parts.
Text tokens processed before audio parts. TurnCompleteEvent signals stream end, ensuring full text display even when audio production stops partway.
fetchAudioChunk uses _headers() with Bearer token from _identity.currentPrincipal. Test verifies authorization header presence on chunk fetch requests.
voiceTurnStream propagates SessionEnded errors via _throwWireErrorFromType when server sends type:'error' frames. Error thrown into stream enables UI mic disable.
